scope: Real production browser HostClient, explicit user click, cross-origin synthetic authorization navigation and built callback under production COOP/COEP/CSP/referrer/cache headers. Main fixture uses only production COOP/COEP. Real CORS token POST with PKCE and session-handle provider HTTP on explicitly allowed loopback HTTP origins. No real provider, external account, TLS deployment, persisted OAuth session, or native Keychain claim. Negative-only popup/BroadcastChannel/isolation faults are identified by their test names. History navigation records actual restoration observations; no BFCache claim without a persisted pageshow observation.
